title: From Follower to Messenger — Romans 10:14
paragraphs: From Follower to Messenger — Romans 10:14
You were never saved just to sit in the crowd.
That’s the sting of Romans 10:14.
“How then shall they call on Him in whom they have not believed? And how shall they believe in Him of whom they have not heard? And how shall they hear without a preacher?”
Pause there.

People are dying for lack of hearing.
Not because Jesus is weak.
Not because the Gospel has lost power.
But because too many redeemed mouths have gone silent.

We love being followers.
We love being fed.
We love the comfort of worship, the safety of Bible studies, the language of faith.
But here’s what we miss…

A true follower of Jesus does not only come to the table.
He carries the invitation.

A true disciple does not only receive mercy.
He announces it.

Romans 10 is not just about pulpits.
It is about people.
Ordinary believers.
Burning hearts.
Open mouths.
Feet willing to go.

Because someone near you is asking questions they do not know how to word.
Someone is drowning in shame but smiling in public.
Someone is waiting for a messenger while we keep waiting for a “perfect moment.”
Listen, kapatid.

The Gospel is still the power of God unto salvation.
Jesus still saves the addict.
Jesus still restores the broken woman.
Jesus still calls the ashamed man out of hiding.
Jesus still forgives sinners, cleanses hearts, and gives dead souls new life.
But how will they hear if we will not speak?

This is the shift.
From spectator to servant.
From consumer to carrier.
From follower to messenger.

Not because you know everything.
Not because you preach perfectly.
But because you have met the Savior who bled for sinners and rose again in victory.
That is enough to start.

Tell them about the cross.
Tell them about the empty tomb.
Tell them that repentance is real.
Tell them grace is not a rumor.
Tell them Jesus Christ is still the only name by which we must be saved.

And if fear is choking your voice, remember this:
the same Lord who saves your soul can strengthen your mouth.

So go.
Speak.
Text the friend.
Call the brother.
Pray with the hurting.
Open your Bible.
Share Christ.
Because heaven’s message was never meant to die inside you.

From follower to messenger.
From hearing to heralding.
From grace received to grace proclaimed.

Jesus did not just call you to come after Him.
He called you to go for Him.

“How shall they hear without a preacher?”
Maybe, for someone near you, that preacher is you.
